project_type: AWS serverless GPU-booking platform (CDK + Python Lambdas + React frontend). This task touches only the Python Lambda code under platform/lambda/.
language: Python (Lambda handlers), TypeScript (CDK infra + frontend). This task is Python-only.
build_system: AWS CDK (platform/cdk.json) for infra; Lambdas are packaged as plain asset directories with NO pip/vendoring step. requirements.txt only lists boto3 (already in the Lambda runtime). This means third-party libs like PyYAML are NOT available at runtime.
test_framework: None exists yet in the repo. Introduce pytest. Host has python3.12 and python3.9; pytest is not installed but network is OPEN_INTERNET so `python3.12 -m pip install pytest` works. Place tests under platform/lambda/tests/ and run with `python3.12 -m pytest`.
build_command: No compile step for the Python Lambdas. Byte-compile check: `python3.12 -m py_compile platform/lambda/api/handler.py platform/lambda/deployer/handler.py`.
verification_instructions: 1) python3.12 -m py_compile on both edited handlers to confirm no syntax errors. 2) python3.12 -m pytest platform/lambda/tests/ -v and confirm all new tests pass. There is no other automated build/test for these Lambdas in the repo.
setup_instructions: python3.12 -m pip install pytest (OPEN_INTERNET). No other setup needed for the Python Lambda code paths under test; the parse function must NOT import boto3 or yaml so unit tests can import it directly without AWS mocking.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN_INTERNET (pip install allowed). Do NOT push, do NOT create MRs, do NOT touch AWS resources. Deployer and api are SEPARATE Lambda packages with no shared import path (api/handler.py does sys.path.insert for its own dir; deployer/handler.py loads sibling modules). The model-extraction helper therefore must be defined independently in BOTH packages (duplicated small pure-Python function), OR added as a new sibling module inside each package. It must work WITHOUT PyYAML (regex/text scan only), mirroring the existing _fallback_has_services_mapping approach in api/handler.py.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch feat/gpu-booking-platform (already checked out; HEAD 1b81b73). Preserve backward compatibility for the 7 built-in plans and existing user plan records. No commits/push/MR by the coder.
key_patterns: Compose files reference the model via an absolute path /opt/dlami/nvme/models/<slug> where <slug> is the HF repo id with '/' replaced by '__'. deployer/handler.py::_get_compose_commands(deployment_plan, compose_file, model_name) uses model_name to build model_local_path = /opt/dlami/nvme/models/{model_name.replace('/', '__')} and to drive the HF snapshot_download. The bug: model_name (from plan record.modelName / DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME) and the path baked into the compose YAML are two independent sources of truth; when they disagree the container reads an empty/wrong dir and health never passes. Real compose writings to support: SGLang `--model-path /opt/dlami/nvme/models/<slug>`, vLLM `--model /opt/dlami/nvme/models/<slug>`, shell `MODEL=/opt/dlami/nvme/models/<slug>`, and compose files with NO model path (e.g. slime-style) where extraction must return nothing and callers fall back. Slug->repo id: replace the FIRST '__' with '/' (org/name; name may contain underscores). All real slugs here contain exactly one '__'.
relevant_files: platform/lambda/deployer/handler.py (PRIMARY bug fix: _get_compose_commands ~line 300, and _handle_deploy user-plan branch ~line 470 where composeFile/modelName are resolved from plan record). Note _load_compose_content already exists and loads the compose text from S3 or bundle.

platform/lambda/api/handler.py (create_deployment_plan ~line 599: on upload, parse the composeContent to derive modelName, store into the plan record; fall back to body.modelName/DEFAULT_PLAN_MODEL when not found. Existing _validate_compose_content / _fallback_has_services_mapping ~line 525 show the no-PyYAML text-scan pattern to mirror.)
platform/lambda/api/models.py (DeploymentPlan dataclass, modelName default 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash' - do not break)
platform/lambda/api/deployment_plans.py (built-in plan registry + user plan merge; reference only)
platform/lambda/deployer/compose-files/*.yaml (real compose examples: all use --model-path with __ slugs)
platform/lambda/requirements.txt (boto3 only - confirms no PyYAML at runtime)
directory_structure: platform/lambda/api/ = API Gateway Lambda (handler.py, deployment_plans.py, models.py, ec2_manager.py, notifications.py). platform/lambda/deployer/ = deployer Lambda (handler.py, notifications.py, compose-files/). platform/lambda/tests/ = to be created for pytest. platform/lambda/requirements.txt shared manifest.
